sources.title: Overcoming Guilt From Sin | David Antwi
sources.description:
Overcoming Guilt From Sin

In “Overcoming Guilt From Sin,” Pastor David Antwi explains how to maximise the atmosphere of worship by not allowing your sins distract you and rather cry out for mercy in the presence of God to overcome them. 

#sin #guilty #guilt #overcome #overcomefailure #overcomefailure #overcomer #davidantwi #kharischurch #church #sermon #fasting #2023sermon #faith #promise #prayer #growth #hope #peace 

If you’ve just made a decision for Christ, please visit HERE: https://kharis.org/k-life/

This sermon is also available in audio:
